en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the courtyard.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we talk about?
I've gotten used to being here...
I want to get outside as soon as I can...
Staying here forever wouldn't be so bad

Yeah, we're definitely gettin' used to
this place...

But that doesn't mean we should stay here
forever! That sounds like a terrible idea!

Just imagine—Miu Iruma, the gorgeous girl
genius, trapped here forever...

Virgins across the world would start
sobbin' into their body pillows!

I may not look like it cuz my tits are so big,
but I've actually got a soft spot for virgins!

Yeah, I can't help but wanna get outta this
cramped place!

I'm a scientist, dammit! I can't test my
inventions on only fifteen subjects!
Let's get the fuck outta this academy, alright!?
And then, let's get to makin' babies!
<CLT=cltMIND>...What?
...Is your head okay?
...I feel sorry for you.

You're clearly goin' crazy.
Must be all the jackin' off you do.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Miu looks deep in thought...
(Hmph...)
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Miu's inner thoughts...?
